settings.heading: We help South Africans lose less.
settings.text: Homeward is a small, registered South African business. We sell one product we believe in, a slim tracker card for iPhone, and we try to sell it the way we'd want to be sold to: honest descriptions, fast delivery, and real people when you need help.

settings.heading: Because a lost wallet costs more than a wallet.
settings.text:
In South Africa, losing your wallet means cancelling cards, waiting weeks for a new driver's licence card and losing a morning at Home Affairs for a new ID. A R300 card that prevents that is an easy decision.

Round tracker tags are great on keys, but they don't fit in a wallet. A card does.

settings.title: Checked before it ships
settings.text: We check stock as it arrives and look over every order before it leaves us.

settings.title: Packed by us
settings.text: Orders are packed by our own team, not an anonymous overseas warehouse.

settings.title: Shipped with Aramex
settings.text: Free, tracked delivery to your door, usually dispatched the same day.

settings.title: Answered by people
settings.text: WhatsApp or email us and someone on our team replies. No bots, no call centre.

settings.bio: Checks, packs and hands every order to Aramex, usually on the day you order.
Answers your WhatsApps and emails, helps with setup and sorts out returns.
Tests new stock and looks after warranty claims, so faulty cards get replaced fast.

settings.heading: The people behind your order
settings.text: We're a small team, and we like it that way. It means the person who packs your order is never far from the person who answers your questions.

settings.heading: If it's not right, we'll make it right.
settings.text:
If your card arrives damaged, stops working, or just isn't for you, tell us. You get 30 days to return it for any reason and a 12-month warranty against faults, on top of your rights under the Consumer Protection Act.

We'd rather lose a sale than a customer's trust.
